verdict.rationale: Independent reviews credit the 285K with strong productivity performance, good power consumption and efficiency, and relaxed cooling requirements. They also call it significantly more power efficient than the 14900K, though AMD's 9950X leads in perf-per-watt. The evidence pack contains no documented power envelope for this SKU and no sustained-load or throttling tests on long renders. missing for 10: documented base/turbo power limits (PL1/PL2/TDP) for the 285K, independent sustained render/export testing showing no throttling, a best-in-class perf-per-watt result versus competitors.
